title: Existential crisis avoided 🙌🏻. Glad I can enjoy some of these program...
transcript: It's my birthday and the worst part about turning 30 is that I have officially started aging out of the youth. Theater discounts. Because if you don't know, a lot of theater companies in New York City will offer very cheap tickets to people under 30, with some even going as high as forty. So I wanted to make this list for any aging millennial like myself who is wondering what programs they still have access to. The shed was the only one I could find that was specifically under 30, so unfortunately this one I no longer qualify for. There are quite a few that are 30 and under, meaning I still have one more year to take advantage of them. Those are theater for a New Audience, Second Stage Pack, and the New York City Ballet. Then we have a bunch that are 35 and under. Signature, M. T. C, Lincoln Center, and Playwrights Horizon. Irish Rep is under 40, and then finally roundabout and Classic Stage, both 40 and under. New York City Center is also 40 and under. Two others that I wanted to shout out that don't have any age requirements Atlantic Theater Company and New York Theater Workshop, which both sell 25 dollar tickets to select previews to anyone any age. Although they do sell out quickly so I hope that helps.
classificationReason: Informational list of age-based ticket discount programs at NYC theater companies. Not a review of or commentary on any specific production.
